package.name: krowd_control_interfaces
package.description: The planning-to-control message contract for the KROWD vehicle: Trajectory (path plus per-pose curvature and target speed), VehicleState (odometry plus curvature) and the obstacle messages. Was krowd_mpc_interfaces until 2026-09-10; nothing in it is MPC-specific and the MPC is not being pursued, so the name was the only thing still tying it to that.
